What happens to it when the host(Toreador that gets tapped) goes to
Torpor?

What happens when the host is burned?

If the 'hosted' vampire changes its clan, is it still unblockable?
(Think Maskika as Archon, changed to Malkavian, with a Madness
Network out).

Messages.Author: Pheersum
Messages.Body:
Thomas Doehne wrote:
>
> Three questions about the Toreador Grand Ball:
>
> What happens to it when the host(Toreador that gets tapped) goes to
> Torpor?
>
> What happens when the host is burned?
>
> If the 'hosted' vampire changes its clan, is it still unblockable?

The requirements for this card to be played are two ready Toreador, and
one of them must be tapped during the play of the card. The Grand Ball
is then affected by directed actions to burn the card.

This seems to me like what happens to a Warzone Hunting Ground in a
mixed clan deck when all your Brujah have been burned. Nothing.

I would think a clan change would just keep the card in play affecting
the same two vampires regardless of what clan they are now.

If the other players don't directly burn the Grand Ball then all its
effects are still active.
